subtitle: Lesson 50 · Computing on data while it moves

eyebrow: SQL, running continuously on the stream
code:
SELECT url, COUNT(*) AS views
FROM   page_view_stream
WINDOWED BY TUMBLING (SIZE 1 MINUTE)
GROUP BY url;

-- emits a fresh result every time
-- the 1-minute window closes
caption: A continuous query, not a one-time batch GROUP BY.
